question: In the BatPaC comparison, how much lower are the total pack cost and the material cost with Co-free cathodes than with NCA cathodes?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (3) AND line_no BETWEEN 14 AND 21 ORDER BY line_no

WITH t AS (SELECT
 (SELECT regexp_extract(text,'\(\$([0-9]+) total',1) FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L18') AS cofree_total,
 (SELECT replace(regexp_extract(text,'\(\$([0-9 ]+) total',1),' ','') FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L19') AS nca_total,
 (SELECT regexp_extract(text,'\$([0-9]+) material',1) FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L18') AS cofree_mat,
 (SELECT regexp_extract(text,'\$([0-9]+) material',1) FROM lines WHERE id='p3.L20') AS nca_mat)
SELECT CAST(nca_total AS INT)-CAST(cofree_total AS INT) AS total_diff, CAST(nca_mat AS INT)-CAST(cofree_mat AS INT) AS mat_diff FROM t
